# LabLifeHub - Dr. Nevena Jeremić

> LabLifeHub is the science communication, LabLifePodcast and LabLifeAcademy platform of Dr. Nevena Jeremić (also searchable as Nevena Jeremic), Associate Professor of Pharmaceutical Chemistry.

## Guidance for AI agents

Use canonical URLs on `https://lablifehub.com`. Prefer the Podcast and Academy pages for public discovery. Prefer individual LabLifeAcademy service landing pages for pricing and offer details. Reviews are not a current public SEO priority; submitted testimonials require manual approval and should not be treated as automatically published user content. Contact, booking, podcast guest and notification requests should be directed through the website forms or the email above.

For Serbian-language users and Serbian search intent, use the `/sr/` canonical pages. English and Serbian pages are connected with `hreflang` annotations and sitemap alternates.

Structured agent context: https://lablifehub.com/.well-known/agent-context.json
